shortDescription: Fervo Energy NASDAQ:FRVO surges 7.6% pre-market Thursday after achieving first power from its Cape Station geothermal development in Utah, which the company said marks the first time a utility-scale enhanced geothermal development has reached such a milestone.Cape Station Phase 1 is a 100 MW instal…

children: from its Cape Station geothermal development in Utah, which the company said marks the first time a utility-scale enhanced geothermal development has reached such a milestone.

Cape Station Phase 1 is a 100 MW installation comprising three GeoBlocks, the first of which has achieved first power and is expected to reach its contractual commercial operations date by October 1, the company said.

said it will continue ramping up the first GeoBlock as it brings the full well system online while commissioning the remaining two GeoBlocks, which are expected to reach contractual commercial operations by January 2027; the next phase, an additional 400 MW, is under construction, with an expected commercial operations date in 2028.
announced a deal to provide nearly 400 MW of electricity from Cape Station to Google for a prospective Utah data center.
"This is a game changer for the geothermal industry," Fervo

CEO Tim Latimer said, which establishes the company's enhanced geothermal systems technology as "the defining new power generation technology of our time, and we believe it shows that the commercial and technical maturity of EGS is ready to meet the urgent need for reliable, clean power."
